frames.label: Root room
frames.detail: Start; spawn in tut-note; XP 0; 0/3 cleared; visits 1; all rooms Open

frames.label: Lower room under low FPS

frames.label: Upper room
frames.detail: Climb ≈3.8 s; visits 3; label drawn in the left half and clear of the ladder

frames.label: Return to root

frames.label: Reload
frames.detail: tut-note / tut-tools / tut-map restored from IndexedDB; sessions 1 → 2; fresh session visits 1; focus on Progress

frames.label: Reduced motion
frames.detail: Separate session with ui.prefersReducedMotion=1; matchMedia true; same layout, camera snaps instead of smoothing
